tools.name: trade-tariff_container-iso6346-validate
tools.description: Validate freight container owner code, category identifier, serial, and ISO 6346 check digit. Does not confirm registration. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/trade-tariff/container-iso6346-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: trade-tariff_customs-bond-type-explain
tools.description: Return a short structured explanation of common CBP customs bond forms and activity codes from public CBP bond concepts. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/trade-tariff/customs-bond-type-explain. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: trade-tariff_us-hts-duty-rate-lookup
tools.description: Return the published HTSUS General, Special and Column 2 rate columns, units and Chapter 99 cross-references for an HTS code from the vendored USITC release. Not a classification or additional-duty calculation. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/trade-tariff/us-hts-duty-rate-lookup. An unpaid call retur

tools.name: trade-tariff_uk-global-tariff-lookup
tools.description: Return the UK Global Tariff third-country (measure type 103) duty for a UK commodity code from a vendored DBT dataset subset. Preferential rates are not included. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/trade-tariff/uk-global-tariff-lookup. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: trade-tariff_us-schedule-b-lookup
tools.description: Look up a 10-digit US Schedule B export code or search Schedule B descriptions in the vendored Census concordance. Not an AES filing. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/trade-tariff/us-schedule-b-lookup. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: trade-tariff_us-airport-lookup
tools.description: Look up a US landing facility by FAA location identifier, ICAO id or name from the vendored FAA NASR 28-day APT_BASE data. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/trade-tariff/us-airport-lookup. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "trade-tariff_us-schedule-b-lookup" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "trade-tariff" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: trade-tariff_container-iso6346-validate, trade-tariff_us-schedule-b-lookup · Public sink: trade-tariff_container-iso6346-validate, trade-tariff_customs-bond-type-explain, trade-tariff_us-hts-duty-rate-lookup, trade-tariff_uk-global-tariff-lookup, trade-tariff_us-schedule-b-lookup, trade-tariff_us-airport-lookup · Destructive: trade-tariff_container-iso6346-validate, trade-tariff_customs-bond-type-explain, trade-tariff_us-hts-duty-rate-lookup, trade-tariff_uk-global-tariff-lookup, trade-tariff_us-schedule-b-lookup, trade-tariff_us-airport-lookup.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
